subject: EOQ: One-off voucher to close Meridian Health pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ: One-off voucher to close Meridian Health pilot

Hi Elena —

Great to speak yesterday. The pilot metrics look promising (attached) — most usage coming from the triage and discharge workflows, and the team reported a 12% faster turnaround on notes during the last two weeks.

We want to make it easy to push this over the line before quarter-end. Would Meridian accept a one-off promotional voucher to extend the pilot capacity and give the engineering team some runway for the integration work? I was thinking of a $3,000 token voucher (roughly 250k tokens) valid through 7/15 to cover any burst usage and finalize the evaluation.

If that sounds useful, I can route this through our sales ops and legal for a short termsheet. I’ve attached the usage export for context (Meridian_Pilot_Usage_2027-06.pdf).

Next steps: if you confirm the ask and any procurement constraints, I’ll get internal approval today so we can deliver formally.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Meridian_Pilot_Usage_2027-06.pdf (usage export, 12 pages)

From: Elena Torres <elena@meridianhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meridianhealth.com, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: One-off voucher to close Meridian Health pilot

Thanks Rafael — and thanks for the summary and the usage file. This could help. A few quick constraints from our side: procurement will only sign off on a voucher if there is an invoiceable or documented credit memo, and we need a one-page justification describing the business impact for their PO.

Also: could the voucher period be pushed to 7/31 instead of 7/15? Our team will be heads-down the week of 7/12 and they’d prefer a longer runway.

CC’ing procurement and Rajiv so they see the ask. If you can send a short termsheet and the justification language, procurement said they’ll try to get the internal PO issued quickly.

— Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Clinical Operations | Meridian Health
elena@meridianhealth.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:17:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: EOQ: One-off voucher to close Meridian Health pilot

Forwarding Elena’s reply — procurement wants an invoiceable credit memo and would prefer the voucher to run through 7/31. They’re asking for a one‑page justification we can send with the PO.

Proposal for internal approval: increase to $3,500 voucher (covers ~290k tokens), valid to 2027-07-31; sales ops issues a one-page justification and finance creates a credit memo. We’ll ask Meridian to sign a short termsheet (attached: EOQ_Voucher_Termsheet_rafael_v1.docx) and request the PO.

Ask: can we get signoff to proceed with $3.5k and 7/31 validity? This is a small, one-off concession to close the pilot and likely upsell in H2 — the product team also flagged that this account has a strong case study potential. I need approval by EOD Monday (6/27 PT) to meet procurement timing.

Thanks — Rafael

Attachments: EOQ_Voucher_Termsheet_rafael_v1.docx (termsheet draft), Meridian_Pilot_Usage_2027-06.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: EOQ: One-off voucher to close Meridian Health pilot

Rafael — approved with conditions.

1) Approve one-off credit of $3,750 (round up) valid through 2027-07-31.
2) Sales must provide a one-paragraph business justification for procurement (I suggest: reduced discharge time, fewer readmits, observed workflow lift — include usage metrics).
3) Finance will need a short internal memo to create a credit memo (I’ll loop in Billing once you send the final justification).
4) Ask for a short case study commitment (6-8 week recap) in exchange for the concession; if not, mark as a conditional approval and escalate.

Rafael — go ahead and send the termsheet to Elena with the updated amount and the justification paragraph. Copy me and I’ll follow up with Billing for the credit memo.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
